metadata.description: Optional Claude Code plugins of agent-crew-kit: quota pacing and the team agent set

plugins.name: quota-pace
plugins.description: The team's single quota pace forecast: weekly use aimed N hours (default 5) before the reset; optional cost statistics (install --cost)

plugins.name: crew-agents
plugins.description: Tools and the proactive-concise output style of the team agent set (<role>-<model><effort>: quick-task-hm ... principal-engineer-omax). The agent files live in agents/ at the repo root and load unprefixed through the ~/.claude/agents/claude-shared link that quota-pace/install makes
